primary_scope_audit.adoption: A holonomic/minimal-dimension module over a formal power series ring over ANY characteristic-zero field satisfies the generalized Bernstein functional equation for ANY formal coefficient function. Its generic-power minimal lattice and filtered generic parameter theorem justify holonomicity of the cyclic lambda^s section after a semilinear integer exponent translation.
